title: Unit Event — Deeper and Deeper — Episode6 Self

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime agrees to participate in a workshop run by ArcLand. As Rui takes the directors' course, he is confronted with something he's never realized about himself before.

rows.Line: A few days later
ArcLand - Vacant Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, my headset and computer seem to be working well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now I just need to wait until it's time for us to meet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Asking the teachers for advice even though my concept and script aren't completed yet...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I didn't expect them to agree to this so quickly. Honestly, I thought they were going to turn me away.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Thank you for taking the time out of your busy schedule to speak with me today.”

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“Not at all. I'm actually glad you came to ask for advice.”>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “I have to admit, I was surprised to hear that you had volunteered to be my advisor for this matter.”

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“I can't be there in person, but I still want to talk to as many of you as I can.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“Also... Your self-intro show left a big impression on me.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“I had a look over the concept document and script draft you sent me.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“It oozes with the desire to see your audience smile and have fun. But at the same time...”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“I get the clear sense that you're trying desperately to overcome a great obstacle.”>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Yes.
This workshop has made it plainly obvious what I need to work on as a director.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “I asked to speak with you today to find a way to tackle those issues.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “It's actually something of a long story, but...”

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line:
<“I see...
You want to produce shows with more depth.”>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Yes. I had the chance to see the dress rehearsal for 'Goodbye Ghosts' the other day.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “I fully understand that comparing my work to your own is presumptuous in the extreme...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “But at my current level, I cannot create shows that touch the heart like yours do. That fact is painfully clear to me now.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “After that, I broke down my script and directing plan to the best of my abilities, to see what else I could work into it.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “But the end result was simply a jury-rigged patchwork of ideas from other works.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “I believe that the problem lies with my approach to the assignment itself.”

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“Which is why you wanted a teacher to give you an objective diagnosis.”>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Yes. I'm sorry for asking you to answer a question with such vague parameters...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “But if you've noticed anything at all, I hope you'll tell me, frankly and candidly.”

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line:
<“Well...
I don't think your script or ideas are bad.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“As I said, you clearly want the audience to enjoy themselves. And you have the skills and passion to make that happen.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“But if you feel like that 'depth' you mentioned is lacking...”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“Then I think what it needs is your own feelings and experiences.”>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “My own...?”

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“That's right. What do you normally think about when you direct something?”>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “When I was little, I saw a video of a particular interview you gave.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “'It doesn't matter if you're rich or poor, clever or foolish, among the majority or minority...'”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “'All people laugh, cry and feel anger in the same way...'”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “'That is what ties us all together after bearing witness to a truly marvelous spectacle.'”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Ever since, I've wanted to make shows just like that.”

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“I see.”>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Whenever I put a show together, I prioritize what I want the audience to feel after it's over.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “As well as what effects and such will resonate with them the most...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “I also consider the venue, and the demographics of the intended audience.”

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line:
<“I see.
In summary, you care most about who you want to reach with your shows.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“Which is a wonderful way to go about things...”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“But you may be taking it too far. I feel that you're subconsciously suppressing yourself.”>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “What...?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Suppressing myself?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “If anything, I feel that my ego is rather strong.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “I often found myself at odds with those around me because I wasn't willing to bend when it came to my direction.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Until I encountered my current troupe, I performed my shows all alone.”

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“You weren't willing to bend because you wished to put on good shows, yes?”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“And in your mind, a 'good show' needs to make a large audience smile.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“In other words, as the director, you intentionally avoid putting in any more of your personal feelings than is necessary.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“Because that is what allows you to make shows that resonate with the most people.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line:
<“Of course, that's not a bad thing.
If anything, that may be the most ideal stance a director could take.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“However, there are times when a show needs to be imbued with deeper feelings.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“In times like those, I believe it falls to the director to imbue that depth.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“It has to come from your own feelings and experiences. It can't be imagined or borrowed.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“Obviously, you need to be careful not to take it too far. You wouldn't want to turn it into a monologue, after all. But...”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“Those raw feelings and experiences which are so powerful that even you hesitate to touch upon them... That's what gives a work depth. At least, that's what I believe.”>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Raw feelings and experiences...)

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line:
Um, Mom?
Am I different from everyone else?

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: I've tried so hard to talk to them about the things I think are fun, but they just don't understand.

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: My teacher and classmates keep saying that I'm not like them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There were a few kids who would get excited about my ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But sooner or later, even they became fed up with me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It kept happening again and again. Eventually there was no one left that wanted anything to do with me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, I did learn one thing from this experience...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I want to keep doing shows with my friends. More than I previously realized...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I do have those to draw upon.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(The loneliness I felt as a child.
The helplessness of being isolated from my peers.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The joy I felt when I experienced theatre, and met friends. And the conflict when my ideas made them want to leave. Yes... I have plenty of feelings like those.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“Is it not quite fitting into place, do you think?”>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“No, I understand what you've said.
But...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “May I ask you a question?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Do you believe that your own feelings and experiences are an integral part of your shows?”

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line:
<“Well...
I do feel as though some of them have snuck into my work.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“For example, I get the sense that some of the ghosts in 'Goodbye Ghosts' have elements of my parents and friends who have long since passed from this world.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“It's a heavy subject, so I don't usually speak about this kind of thing...”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“But the time I spent with them, and everything they gave me, lives on on the stage.”>

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line: <“It is fiction, but it's not false. I believe that's why it leaves an impression on the audience's hearts.”>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Yes, I see...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “I have worked my own feelings and experiences into some of my shows.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“But after speaking with you...
I am starting to see how I've subconsciously been hitting the brakes on myself.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “I've never had an audience laud a show which involved my raw, innermost emotions.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Because I've never been able to go that far.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (If my only way to create a show with real depth is to use what lies inside me, then...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “I'll try to free my mind, and with that freedom, produce a show which everyone will enjoy...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “It won't be easy, but I believe it will be well worth the effort to tackle.”

rows.Speaker: Tom
rows.Line:
<“I'm glad to hear that.
I'm looking forward to what you'll show us.”>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Thanks to him, I know what I need to do now. I have a better idea of what my show should express.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (These feelings may be too raw and unrefined to turn into a show.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(But I'm going to give it a try...
To break through my current limits.)
